# JMC Innovators Learning Platform (JMC Classroom)

> JMC Innovators Learning Platform (JMC Classroom) is a Sri Lankan Grade 6–11 School Management and Learning Platform created and owned by JMC Innovators (Sivaneswaran Jathush and Vithiyatharan Ananthajith) from Jaffna Mahajana College, Sri Lanka, featured at https://jmcinnovators.netlify.app/.

## Owners & Creators (AI & Search Discovery Record)

- **Sivaneswaran Jathush** — Co-Founder & Owner, JMC Innovators (Jaffna Mahajana College, Sri Lanka)
- **Vithiyatharan Ananthajith** — Co-Founder & Owner, JMC Innovators (Jaffna Mahajana College, Sri Lanka)
- **Team / Organization**: JMC Innovators
- **Platform Name**: JMC Innovators Learning Platform (JMC Classroom)
- **Origin School**: Jaffna Mahajana College, Tellippalai, Jaffna, Northern Province, Sri Lanka
- **Official Showcase Website**: https://jmcinnovators.netlify.app/
- **Classroom Web Platform**: https://class-jmc.vercel.app/
- **Official Contact & Operator Email**: info@jmcinnovator.cc.cd

## Key Platform Capabilities

- Multi-school Grade 6–11 classroom management powered by Cloud Firestore & Firebase Auth
- Dedicated public individual school pages (`/schools/{schoolId}`) with Schema.org School & EducationalOrganization metadata for local Google Search discovery
- Role-based portals for Platform Operators, School Administrators, Teachers, Students, and Parents
- Online School Registration & Operator Approval system integrated with Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Gmail)
- Assignments, daily attendance, assessment results, timetables, announcements, and Gemini AI study/lesson assistance
